instruction: Start with gui_003_shaft.step in SolidWorks, a single stepped shaft along X. On this machine, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_003_shaft.step`. The 30 mm diameter left segment spans X=-10 to X=50, and the 22 mm diameter right segment spans X=50 to X=100; both segments share the Y=0, Z=0 axis. On the 30 mm segment, cut a top keyway open toward +Z, width 8 mm in Y, depth 3 mm from the top surface, length 35 mm in X, centered at X=20 and Y=0 with a flat bottom at Z=12. Add 1 mm chamfers to the two circular shaft end edges at X=-10 and X=100. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_003_shaft_keyway_out.step as a single solid with the axis still along X.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
